description: A photograph depicting a straight, man-made canal in an urban environment, identified as a canal in Lingen, Lower Saxony, Germany, from Eurostat LUCAS data, 2012. The canal features light-coloured concrete banks, with a series of steps leading down to the water on the left side. The water surface is calm and reflects the clear blue sky. On both sides of the canal, there are landscaped green areas with grass and small trees. In the background, multi-story residential buildings with reddish-brown facades are visible on the left, and a more distant urban skyline appears on the right. This image illustrates the "Highly modified water courses and canals" category (8.1.2) as defined in the associated documentation, which includes artificial water courses according to the Water Framework Directive (Directive 2000/60/EC).
